node.title: k multipliers => collisions lie in the ternary kernel of an EXPLICIT k x N' integer matrix (GV-favorable at k ~ 10)
node.statement: REFUTED (wave-1 packet, Lemma 1): the k-multiplier residue matrix is an OUTER PRODUCT mod p — rank 1 for every k — so the stacked ternary kernel equals the single relation's kernel and the GV counting presupposed independence that never holds. Additionally (Theorem 2, by exhaustion): zero good multipliers exist at every tested (N', p), with best-achievable residues far above threshold. Retained as scoping; see qa16_multiplier_impossibility.md.
